description: 8-channel analog input Ethernet I/O server (Modbus/TCP): measured values in the input registers, configuration, alarm thresholds and SNMP trap settings in the holding registers
notes: Modbus/TCP on port 502; functions 03, 04, 06 (and 01, 02, 05, 15 for digital modules). The manual lists addresses in hex and as PLC addresses (40001/30001 + hex address), so the address here is the hex address as sent on the wire.
The eight analog inputs are input registers 0-7 (FC04, signed 16-bit). The input range is one setting for the whole module (holding register 10).

The three SNMP trap IP registers that the manual labels twice (0023 and 0027) are assigned by their position: low word then high word for IP2, high word then low word for IP3 and IP4. The manual's own labels for those two registers contradict the formulas it gives.
Written from the manufacturer's manual; not tested on a device.

registers.name: Watchdog enable
registers.description: 0x0000 disable, 0xFF00 enable.

registers.name: Watchdog cycle count
registers.description: 0x0001-0x00FF; cycle time = 0.1 s x value.

registers.name: Host watchdog status
registers.description: Read: 0x0000 module OK, 0xFF00 host watchdog failed. Write 0xFF00 to reset the status.

registers.name: Firmware version
registers.description: Reads 0xF12A.

registers.name: Module name
registers.description: Reads 0x6510.

registers.name: Reset status
registers.description: 0x0000 after being read; 0x0001 after the module has been reset.

registers.name: Input range
registers.description: Applies to all channels. Code 0x08 +-10 V, 0x09 +-5 V, 0x0A +-1 V, 0x0B +-500 mV, 0x0C +-150 mV, 0x0D +-20 mA.

registers.name: Offset calibration
registers.description: Write 0xFF00 to start the offset calibration; reads as not used.

registers.name: Span calibration
registers.description: Write 0xFF00 to start the span calibration; reads as not used.

registers.name: Masked AD channels
registers.description: Low byte: one bit per channel, 1 enabled, 0 disabled.

registers.name: Alarm enable
registers.description: One bit per channel (bit 0 = channel 0), 1 enabled, 0 disabled.

registers.name: SNMP trap number
registers.description: 0 to 4; 0 closes the SNMP trap.

registers.name: SNMP trap IP1 low word
registers.description: Read/write AABB: IP = X.X.AA.BB.

registers.name: SNMP trap IP1 high word
registers.description: AABB: IP = AA.BB.X.X.

registers.name: SNMP trap IP2 low word
registers.description: AABB: IP = X.X.AA.BB.

registers.name: SNMP trap IP2 high word
registers.description: AABB: IP = AA.BB.X.X. The manual labels this register "IP2 Lo-Word" a second time; the high word is assumed.

registers.name: SNMP trap IP3 high word
registers.description: AABB: IP = AA.BB.X.X.

registers.name: SNMP trap IP3 low word
registers.description: AABB: IP = X.X.AA.BB.

registers.name: SNMP trap IP4 high word
registers.description: AABB: IP = AA.BB.X.X.

registers.name: SNMP trap IP4 low word
registers.description: The manual labels this register "IP4 Hi-Word" but gives IP = AA.BB.X.X for both 0026 and 0027; the low word is assumed.

registers.name: Repeat enable SNMP trap
registers.description: Write 0xFF00.

registers.name: Analog input channel 0
registers.description: Value in mV for +-10 V and +-5 V; in 0.1 mV for +-1 V, +-500 mV and +-150 mV; in uA for +-20 mA (e.g. +-20 mA = -20000 to +20000).

registers.description: Value in mV for +-10 V and +-5 V; in 0.1 mV for +-1 V, +-500 mV and +-150 mV; in uA for +-20 mA (e.g. +-20 mA = -20000 to +20000).
